desc: Derive the structural characterization that an optimal solution has cost at most 3 when feasible, with cost-1/cost-2 patterns as stated.
Fix mixed cost-2 reconstruction tie-breaking so sample 1 selects the earlier `[1,4]` containment interval rather than `[2,5]`, then run sample tests.
Validate the implementation logic against boundary cases: M=1/2, equal intervals, touching intervals, full-range intervals, and N=1.
Provide a rigorous correctness argument for all cost-1, cost-2, cost-3, and infeasible cases.
